result.title: Refactor Mistral Vibe Session Analysis & Plugin Logs

answers.answer: Dual support: Auto-detect both modern unified store (v1) and legacy messages.jsonl formats
Separate linked sessions: Store child sessions as distinct records with parent_session_id and namespaced agent_type (e.g., ruby-dev:verifier)

Plugin Identification: Detect and record active plugins loaded during the session in session metadata
Subagent Attribution: Attribute child sessions to their defining plugin in agentType (e.g. ruby-dev:implementer)
Quiescent/completed only: Only sync sessions marked quiescent or whose lock has cleared
